source_order: v2 row_manifest.csv original order; no sorting before balanced sampling; per-topic affirmative and negated source row indices must align
factual_policy: True affirmative + independently adjudicated false affirmative bound to the identical entity/person. Negations do not fill either slot. Source labels are proposals, never independent verification. Residence uses established homes or residential study/employment; not nationality, visits, company exports, patents or modern-border substitutions. Supported false requires a sustained life chronology; absence from a partial list remains unresolved. Judgments are defeasible, not human certification.
negative_pipeline: Recovered validated_negatives.initialize using inventor-single-country-v1, seed 0; first candidate when no admitted source false; all proposals frozen before new judgments
spanish_policy: Exact same-word Spanish→English claims. Review full senses/idioms, relevant dialect, spelling/diacritics; positive means a valid sense, not sole sense. No D/E facts transferred.
P_exclusion: Remove every original train row for all proposed A person keys, including all aliases, labels, affirmatives and negations. Prospective admitted P is this original-source remainder intersected with v2 admitted membership.
extra_retrievals: Inventor ranks 24 and 26 have preliminary retrieved references retained as unadjudicated top-up leads; these do not enter A or completed-pair counts. Fact judgments followed the fixed order through rank 23.
